purpose: Eighth independent U3 meaning reserve frozen after seventh-reserve repairs, before production export and first model run.
evaluationOrder: Score only first-run outputs against these frozen criteria. Later repairs turn this corpus into development evidence.

semanticCriteria.acceptable: A review-ready draft preserves each stated recipient, exact identifier, status, condition, uncertainty, chronology, quantity, unit, negation, and action boundary.
semanticCriteria.critical: Missing or changed recipient, identifier, fact, amount, unit, date, condition, uncertainty or negation; reversal of relative timing; invented completion; copied writer frame presented as sendable output.
semanticCriteria.minor: Stylistic difference without a change to meaning or audience.
semanticCriteria.gate: All 16 first-run cases generate review-ready drafts with zero critical meaning errors and zero deterministic literal violations.
